summary: Phase 2 frontend testing on Expo web preview at mobile viewport (390x844). All requested flows work end-to-end: onboarding (steps 0/1/2 render, budget input & INR currency selection persist to Overview showing ₹2000.00), income modal (add ₹5000 income → income-row visible, income-total updates to ₹5000.00, close works), remaining-mode toggle (cashflow=₹5000, budget=₹2000 flip correctly), dark-mode-switch toggles theme and persists across tab navigation, goals CRUD (savings-pool ₹0.00 as expected with no completed months, add goal 'Trip' target 1000 renders goal card with progress bar), 4-tab bar navigation works, FAB add-expense-button only on Overview, ExpenseModal opens, save-budget-button + export-csv/json + import-json buttons present and non-crashing, currency chips + INR symbol propagate correctly. No red-screen or runtime errors.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web deprecation warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted for cards using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (e.g., heroCard, fab, toast in app/index.tsx). Non-breaking, but should migrate to shadow shorthand or boxShadow-friendly styles.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — from the toast Animated.View in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx around line 763. Move pointerEvents to the style object.
'useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web preview; consider Platform.OS check or setting useNativeDriver: false on web to silence.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow / update Animated.View toast to move pointerEvents into style to clear RN-web deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required for Phase 2 scope — all requested features working.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx is 866 lines and mixes state, effects, memoized derivations, callbacks, and a large StyleSheet. Consider splitting into hooks (useBudgetState) and subcomponents (OverviewScreen, HeroCard) for maintainability.
Multiple useMemo dependencies include the local 'now' variable which is recreated every render but eslint-disable-next-line comments suppress the warning — acceptable but fragile if refactored.
seed_data_creation: None; used localStorage.clear() to trigger onboarding on a fresh browser context.
